title: Industrial Coolant Chiller Immersion Type: Engineering Precision Cooling for Process Critical Applications
overviewDescription: There's a reason immersion-based cooling has held its ground in large scale industrial environments for decades. When you're dealing with several thousand litres of process fluid, a chemical bath that can't tolerate a two degree swing, or a brewery wort tank that needs to hit pitching temperature before the yeast window closes surface mounted cooling systems start looking like a bad idea. The chiller immersion method solves for exactly this scenario.
overviewsubDescription: Seppa Solutions' SEPPA DIP series is built on this principle. The unit houses a stainless steel 304 cooling coil that submerges directly into the coolant side of the process tank, enabling aggressive heat transfer right at the source of thermal load.
featuresTitle: Key Engineering Features of the SEPPA DIP Series
featuresSubtitle: The SEPPA DIP series is meticulously engineered to provide exceptional cooling for immersion-based process applications.

features.title: SS 304 Immersion Coil Construction
features.description: SS 304 handles a wide range of process fluids without corroding or leaching contamination. Coil geometry is customizable (immersion depth, coil diameter, pitch spacing) to optimize the convective heat transfer coefficient.

features.title: Fluid Agitation Requirements
features.description: A chiller immersion coil only performs at rated capacity when there's adequate fluid movement. Tank agitation is specified alongside the cooling unit to ensure consistent turbulence over the coil surface.

features.title: Low Noise, Compact Footprint
features.description: The SEPPA DIP runs at low acoustic output compared to large frame industrial cooling units, sharing floor space neatly between processing and packaging lines.

applicationsSubtitle: Versatile industrial applications where direct immersion cooling performs best.

applications.title: Brewery Wort Cooling
applications.description: Immersion wort chiller configuration drops wort from boiling to pitching temperatures (18-22°C for ale, 8-12°C for lager) within a two-hour window for large volume tanks.

applications.title: Chemical Processing and Plating Baths
applications.description: Electroplating and etching operations run process chemistry at very specific temperatures where tanks cannot overshoot or undershoot setpoints.

applications.title: General Manufacturing Coolant Loops
applications.description: Works as an equipment cooling system across closed loops like hydraulic units, CNC coolant tanks, and injection moulding where central chilled water is unavailable.

whyChoose.title: Why Manufacturers Choose Seppa Solutions
whyChoose.description: The glycol chiller system you receive is configured specifically for your application, tank geometry, process fluid, and installation constraints.
paragraphs: Seppa isn't positioning itself as a catalogue supplier. The engineering team works from your tank geometry and fluid properties to optimize thermodynamic limits.
As an industrial chiller manufacturer, Seppa understands that chiller immersion hardware needs to survive aggressive CIP cycles and actual plant floor ambient conditions.
The SEPPA DIP series coil construction, compressor selection, and control architecture are all specified with long-term service life in mind.

methodology.title: Methodology: How the Immersion Type Coolant Chiller Works
methodology.subtitle: Direct Immersion Cooling Cycle

steps.title: Thermodynamic Sequence
steps.description: The stainless coil sits inside the process tank, fully submerged. Liquid refrigerant enters the coil and begins absorbing heat directly.

steps.title: Evaporation Cycle
steps.description: As the refrigerant absorbs heat, it evaporates. This vapour returns to the compressor, gets compressed and condensed, and repeats.

steps.title: Direct Heat Exchange
steps.description: The contact area avoids intermediary heat exchange surfaces, keeping fluid cycling past the coil rather than sitting in a thermal dead zone.

steps.title: Microprocessor Control
steps.description: The microprocessor controller monitors refrigerant pressures and process temperatures, adjusting output to hold setpoints during heat load variations.

faqs.question: What materials are compatible with the SEPPA DIP immersion coil?
faqs.answer: The SS 304 coil handles most fluids like brine, propylene glycol, mild cleaning agents, and water based coolants. Alternative alloys can be specified for aggressive acids.

faqs.question: How does Seppa size a chiller immersion unit for high viscosity fluids?
faqs.answer: Viscosity affects heat transfer. Seppa calculates the revised heat transfer rate, adjusts coil surface area, and specifies the required agitation system.

faqs.question: Is an immersion wort chiller more efficient than an external plate exchanger for brewery applications?
faqs.answer: For large volume tanks, the immersion wort chiller wins on simplicity and hygiene, eliminating pump circuits and reducing CIP complexity.

faqs.question: What makes a well designed equipment cooling system critical for process quality?
faqs.answer: Temperature variation directly affects product consistency. An undersized cooling unit introduces variation that compounds downstream.

faqs.question: What sets Seppa Solutions apart as an industrial chiller manufacturer?
faqs.answer: Seppa's approach is application specific rather than product catalogue driven, optimizing tank geometry and fluid properties for long term durability.
